scientific_integrity: Proof uses classical Euler tours, BEST and directed matrix-tree theorem. Novelty claims limited to the extremal packing, arbitrary orientation realizability and uniform exact enumeration. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Order-three de Bruijn cycles and length-four consecutive squares only; no nonextremal spectrum or higher-order result. Exhaustive checks q=2,3, determinant checks q<=4; other alphabets follow from the proof, not finite experiments. An equivalent unindexed result remains possible.
title: Sharp square packing and orientation-uniform enumeration in order-three de Bruijn cycles
